blocks.html: As people cautiously start to step out of their homes to dine out again under the new normal, Robinsons Malls has provided its patrons with a breezy and calming Al Fresco dining area by launching “The Garden.” Located at Robinsons Magnolia, The Garden is open from 11:00 AM to 9:00 PM during Mondays to Thursdays and from 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM on Fridays to Sundays.

You can order take out from any of your favorite food kiosk, café or restaurant or have your food delivered straight to your table when you order from partner establishments that include Cibo, Max’s, Fiery Style, Mesa, Akira, Kamicos, Sumosam, UCC Park Café, Pho Hoa, Kaya Korean Restaurant and Black Scoop. All you need to do is scan the QR code located at the tables to view the restaurant’s menu and contact details.

The Garden can accommodate around 40 to 50 people with safe social distancing. You can also reserve a table before going to the mall by filling up the online reservation form or call/message Robbie and Rosie, the mall’s personal shoppers, at 0921-499-2958 and wait for confirmation.

The Robinsons Magnolia’s garden area is no doubt everyone’s favorite place to hang out, aside from the bright and vibrant view, it is also peaceful and quiet. It is definitely the perfect place for intimate and cozy conversations with your loved ones.

Aside from the comfortable outdoor dining experience, you can also do a lot of activities like relax with your pets after taking them to the pet park or simply letting them run around the beautiful, lush garden. There’s also a giant chess set nearby where you can practice your mental and strategic skills with your friends and family. And since we are celebrating the Women’s Month, you must not miss the string quartet performance featuring women musicians on March 7, 13, 20, and 27 at 3:00 PM.
No need to worry about your safety as Robinsons Magnolia ensures that chairs and tables are sanitized after every use. Wearing of face mask and face shield are required except when eating.

To see the complete line-up of upcoming performances, events & promos, visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or its Virtual Directory bit.ly/RMallsVirtualMallDirectory; or follow RobinsonsMalls on Facebook; @RobinsonsMallsOfficial on Instagram; and @RobinsonsMalls on Twitter.
